title: Application-send turn shadow policy verification
scope: Verify shadow-only observation, deterministic recommendation, provenance, replay, and force-legacy rollback for application_send_turn_planning. Do not claim a policy winner, active behavior, fairness improvement, latency improvement, or production readiness.
verification_method: Deterministic requirement-home and property tests, focused scheduler and lifecycle correctness tests, allocation and mechanism-cost benchmarks outside correctness CI, permanent local disabled-versus-observe-only and shadow campaigns, schema/checksum validation, and deterministic offline replay.
preconditions: The receive-credit and stream-capacity correctness checkpoint remains preserved.
The application-send force and construction-provenance contract remains green.
All adjacent policy axes are fixed at legacy_current.
The runtime default and applied shadow behavior are legacy_current.
procedure: Validate the new requirement, architecture, work-item, and verification artifacts independently.
Build the relevant projects in Release before testing.
Run deterministic requirement-home tests for disabled, observe-only, shadow, forced, rollback, safe-boundary latch, transition, fallback, and reason precedence.
Run bounded property sequences covering duplicate, delayed, missing, stale, saturated, contradictory, out-of-order, cancellation, disposal, FIN, reset, shutdown, loss, and recovery events.
Run focused scheduler, queue, congestion, pacing, flow-control, ownership, and buffer-limit tests.
Run BenchmarkDotNet mechanism checks only through the nightly or manual performance workflow and retain allocation results.
Run the complete Release correctness suite with Category!=Performance.
Run permanent local disabled-versus-observe-only and shadow replay cells with exact payload and provenance validation.
Validate raw, construction, normalized, curated, and split joins, checksums, exclusions, and axis attribution.
Run deterministic offline replay and prove force-legacy rollback before requesting multi-host shadow review.
expected_result: Every shadow observation produces a versioned deterministic recommendation or conservative fallback with a bounded reason; legacy_current remains applied; no recommendation reaches the scheduler; every forced value retains safety guards; replay is exact; axis provenance and exclusions are append-only; disabled and observe-only paths meet neutrality expectations; and force-legacy rollback restores the null-planner baseline.
status_summary: In progress. The deterministic controller, bounded runtime observe-only and shadow capture, null-planner rollback, separate raw-host evidence stream, closed raw schema, standalone raw-to-epoch conversion, permanent runner invocation, checksum inventory, result/sample/raw-source joins, bounded model-feature transform, and axis-specific analysis adapter are implemented. The adapter validates manifest checksums and complete row-ID coverage, separates sample-scoped descriptive outcomes from epoch features, audits prohibited production inputs, and emits a null proposal when honest holdouts are blocked. Release builds passed with zero warnings; focused controller, runtime, rollback, raw-host, schema, observe-only conversion, shadow conversion, checksum, duplicate-turn, runner contract, evidence-join, dataset, and analysis-chain tests passed. One retained local shadow cell produced schema-valid corrected evidence and a normalized dataset, but disabled-versus-observe-only neutrality, complete Release correctness, counterfactual multi-host coverage, offline rule replay, and campaign rollback evidence remain open. No behavior-distinct planner, policy winner, active behavior, or production readiness is claimed.
